question: Which of the following ionic compounds has the highest boiling point?
solution:
The correct answer is __**CaCl2**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

** CaCl2 (Calcium Chloride)**

__
 
• **Chemical Nature:** An inorganic salt composed of calcium and chlorine ions.
 
• **Properties:** White, crystalline solid, highly soluble in water, hygroscopic (absorbs moisture from the air).
 
• **Uses:** De-icing roads, dust control, food additive, desiccant (drying agent).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**NaCl (Sodium Chloride)**

 
• **Chemical Nature:** Common table salt, an ionic compound of sodium and chlorine.
 
• **Properties:** White, crystalline solid, readily dissolves in water, essential for human and animal life.
 
• **Uses:** Seasoning food, preserving food, industrial applications (e.g., chemical production).

**MgCl2 (Magnesium Chloride)**

 
• **Chemical Nature:** An inorganic salt of magnesium and chlorine.
 
• **Properties:** White, crystalline solid, highly soluble in water, deliquescent (absorbs moisture from the air and dissolves in it).
 
• **Uses:** De-icing roads, fireproofing agents, magnesium production, nutritional supplement.

**LiCl (Lithium Chloride)**

 
• **Chemical Nature:** An inorganic salt of lithium and chlorine.
 
• **Properties:** White, crystalline solid, highly soluble in water and polar organic solvents.
 
• **Uses:** Batteries (lithium-ion batteries), air conditioning systems, psychiatric medications.
